note: Knox County's only public parcel layer (Knox_V4 MapServer/1129, 33,239 polygons) has supportsPagination=false; every paged query fails with 'Pagination is not supported' in 4 validations, so it cannot be read by the runtime. The AGOL KnoxV1 copy is not publicly accessible and no free bulk download exists (only paid Regrid/Rockford Map). If the county enables pagination or posts a file, a spec with PARCELID/owner1_name/site_addr/gross_ac/class would work.
